title: Phishbowl Microsoft Sentinel playbook (draft export)
description: Schema for the Microsoft Sentinel playbook artifact Phishbowl emits: an Azure Resource Manager deployment template for a Logic App workflow. DRAFT / EXPORT ONLY: the workflow ships disabled (properties.state is const "Disabled") behind a manual request trigger and carries only inert Compose actions that hold the triage verdict and indicators. Importing it never auto-runs, and Phishbowl never quarantines, blocks, sends, or acts.

workflowProperties.description: state is const "Disabled": a draft playbook is never imported in a running state, so it cannot fire until an analyst reviews and enables it.

action.description: Every action must be an inert Compose step (type is const "Compose"). A Compose action only emits a constant value — it calls no connector and cannot egress, block, quarantine, or remediate — so this constraint is what makes schema validation prove the workflow stays inert. An ApiConnection / Http / connector action would fail here.

triggers.description: Exactly one manual request trigger is allowed — additional properties are forbidden, so a template wired to an automatic Microsoft Sentinel incident/alert or recurrence trigger cannot validate and can never fire on its own.
